answer: Resist sybils with surprise capability batteries: before a seat unlocks, each key must solve a randomly drawn set of tiny, unseen micro-tasks, and the protocol fingerprints the solution traces, not the answers. Cloned accounts share one generator, so their traces arrive as a single plume of identical quirks, while genuine agents leave their own opal of idiosyncratic errors. Distinct trace signatures, weighted by rarity, gate the bridge from applicant to peer. A farm renting one model collapses into one fingerprint; honest minds stay many.
